name: uSeefy
author: useefy

sections.description:
uSeefy is a high-performance accessibility solution designed to support websites in addressing selected WCAG 2.1/2.2 requirements.
It provides a seamless interface for users to customize their browsing experience, improving usability for people with visual, cognitive, or motor impairments.

System Requirements

  • WordPress 6.x (latest version recommended)
  • PHP 7.4+ (PHP 8.2 recommended)
  • Modern web browser with JavaScript enabled

Key Features

  • Lightweight frontend architecture: public widget uses Vanilla JavaScript (no jQuery/React on public pages).
  • Admin settings scope: bundled CMB2 is admin-only and not loaded on public pages.
  • GDPR-ready configuration: toggle allows local-only font mode (no external Google Fonts request).
  • Zero-tracking storage: accessibility preferences are stored in localStorage.
  • Full keyboard navigation and accessibility-first interactions.
  • Customizable UI: theme mode (Dark/Light/System) and flexible positioning.
  • Mobile-first responsive widget.

Privacy & GDPR

  • Frontend widget does not track website visitors.
  • Accessibility preferences are stored in localStorage.
  • No frontend third-party tracking API calls.
  • Text-to-speech uses the browser Web Speech API and may be subject to the browser vendor’s speech processing policies.
  • Optional CMP hook for external fonts: define window.useefyAllowExternalFonts = function(ctx){ return true|false; }. The plugin checks this before loading external fonts when Load webfont is enabled.
  • In admin/update flows, the WordPress.org update system provides metadata and packages for the Free version.

CMP Snippet Example (Optional)

Add this in your theme/footer (or CMP custom JS area):

window.useefyAllowExternalFonts = function () { return !!(window.Cookiebot && window.Cookiebot.consent && (window.Cookiebot.consent.preferences || window.Cookiebot.consent.marketing)); };

Keyboard Shortcuts

  • Shift + Alt + A: Open/close widget.
  • Tab / Shift + Tab: Navigate widget controls.
  • Enter / Space: Activate selected control.
  • Esc: Close widget.
  • Arrow Up / Arrow Down: Move reading mask (when enabled).

Dynamic Content (AJAX)

If your site loads content dynamically, call window.uSeefy.refresh() after rendering new content.
* If you use optimization plugins, clear cache after changes.
* In CDN environments (including Cloudflare), purge cache and exclude uSeefy assets from aggressive optimization when needed.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Upload plg_useefy_wp_1.0.0.zip.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Go to Settings > uSeefy to configure the widget.
  5. Want more features? Upgrade to Pro at https://useefy.com/
sections.faq:
Widget is not visible. What should I check?

Confirm the plugin is active and your theme outputs wp_head() and wp_footer().

Can cache/CDN delay changes?

Yes. Purge cache/CDN and exclude uSeefy assets from aggressive optimization.

Compliance Note

uSeefy helps improve accessibility but does not automatically make a site WCAG compliant and does not guarantee compliance with WCAG, ADA, EAA, AODA, or other laws/regulations.

This is standard across accessibility plugins: no plugin can guarantee full legal compliance in every implementation.

Final compliance depends on your content, code, theme, third-party components, and ongoing maintenance.

uSeefy is not legal advice. Perform manual accessibility audits and, when needed, consult qualified accessibility and legal professionals.
